RAY_MOD_CARD_PARANORMAL_TAPE.smartDescri: Set your [gold]Depth[/gold] to a random number between {MinRollDepth:diff()} and {MaxRollDepth:diff()}, then gain Block equal to {BlockPercent:diff()}% of the new [gold]Depth[/gold] and deal damage equal to {DamagePercent:diff()}% of it.
RAY_MOD_CARD_SEE_THE_LIGHT.title: See the Light
RAY_MOD_CARD_SEE_THE_LIGHT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Stun the enemy. Your next Attack costs 0.
If you have at least {AmmoCost} [blue]Ammo[/blue] after playing this, return it to your hand and lose {AmmoCost} [blue]Ammo[/blue].

RAY_MOD_CARD_ACCUMULATE.title: Accumulate
RAY_MOD_CARD_ACCUMULATE.description:
At the start of your next combat, your [gold]Depth[/gold] becomes the value it had at the end of the previous one.
Carries over for one combat only.
RAY_MOD_CARD_ACCUMULATE.smartDescription:
At the start of your next combat, your [gold]Depth[/gold] becomes the value it had at the end of the previous one.
Carries over for one combat only.
RAY_MOD_CARD_INFINITE.title: Infinite
RAY_MOD_CARD_INFINITE.description: This turn, your [blue]Ammo[/blue] can exceed your [blue]Ammo cap[/blue].
RAY_MOD_CARD_INFINITE.smartDescription: This turn, your [blue]Ammo[/blue] can exceed your [blue]Ammo cap[/blue].
RAY_MOD_CARD_TRAVEL.title: Travel
RAY_MOD_CARD_TRAVEL.description: Can only be played if your [gold]Depth[/gold] is less than {MaxPlayableDepth:diff()}. Prevent the next {BufferCharges:diff()} HP loss you would take.
RAY_MOD_CARD_TRAVEL.smartDescription: Can only be played if your [gold]Depth[/gold] is less than {MaxPlayableDepth:diff()}. Prevent the next {BufferCharges:diff()} HP loss you would take.
RAY_MOD_CARD_PET_BLOGGER.title: Pet Blogger
RAY_MOD_CARD_PET_BLOGGER.description: When you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], instead apply 1 [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] mark to every enemy and deal {HitDamage} damage to every marked enemy.
RAY_MOD_CARD_PET_BLOGGER.smartDescriptio: When you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], instead apply 1 [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] mark to every enemy and deal {HitDamage} damage to every marked enemy.
RAY_MOD_CARD_WINGED_STEP.title: Winged Step
RAY_MOD_CARD_WINGED_STEP.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. All cards in your hand whose current cost is greater than {CostThreshold:diff()} cost 0 until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_WINGED_STEP.smartDescriptio: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. All cards in your hand whose current cost is greater than {CostThreshold:diff()} cost 0 until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_GET_RICH.title: Get Rich
RAY_MOD_CARD_GET_RICH.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Double the cost of two random cards in your hand until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_GET_RICH.smartDescription: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Double the cost of two random cards in your hand until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_STRANGE_TREASURE.title: Strange Treasure
RAY_MOD_CARD_STRANGE_TREASURE.descriptio: Whenever you play a card that costs 0, set a random card in your draw pile to cost 0 until played, and double the cost of a random card in your hand until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_STRANGE_TREASURE.smartDescr: Whenever you play a card that costs 0, set a random card in your draw pile to cost 0 until played, and double the cost of a random card in your hand until played.
RAY_MOD_CARD_ESCAPE_ARROW.title: Escape Arrow
RAY_MOD_CARD_BULLET_MODE.title: Bullet Mode
RAY_MOD_CARD_BULLET_MODE.description:
Your cards cost [blue]Ammo[/blue] instead of Energy.
You cannot play a card you cannot afford with [blue]Ammo[/blue]; for X-cost cards, X becomes your current [blue]Ammo[/blue]. At the start of each turn, gain {AmmoPerTurn:diff()} [blue]Ammo[/blue].

You cannot play a card you cannot afford with [blue]Ammo[/blue]; for X-cost cards, X becomes your current [blue]Ammo[/blue]. At the start of each turn, gain {AmmoPerTurn:diff()} [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_CARD_ENGROSSED.title: Engrossed
RAY_MOD_CARD_ENGROSSED.description:
Attacks that actually spend [blue]Ammo[/blue] deal {AmmoBonusPercent:diff()}% more damage.
Each time you attack the same enemy, your next attack against it deals {PerStackBonusPercent:diff()}% more damage (no cap; resets when you switch targets).

RAY_MOD_CARD_PROVE_WHAT.title: Prove What?
RAY_MOD_CARD_PROVE_WHAT.description:
Can only be played if your [gold]Depth[/gold] is greater than {RequiredDepth:diff()}. Play every Attack card in your draw pile, hand and discard pile (except this one), ignoring all conditions.
You die at the start of your next turn.

RAY_MOD_CARD_REFACTORING_BULLETS.title: Refactoring Bullets
RAY_MOD_CARD_REFACTORING_BULLETS.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next two Attacks deal additional damage equal to{IfUpgraded:show: twice} your current [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_CARD_REFACTORING_BULLETS.smartDe: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next two Attacks deal additional damage equal to{IfUpgraded:show: twice} your current [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_CARD_NURTURE.title: Nurture
RAY_MOD_CARD_NURTURE.description: Whenever you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], add an equal number of "Sand Beast" cards to your hand (summons caused by playing the "Sand Beast" card don't count).
RAY_MOD_CARD_NURTURE.smartDescription: Whenever you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], add an equal number of "Sand Beast" cards to your hand (summons caused by playing the "Sand Beast" card don't count).
RAY_MOD_CARD_HOLOGRAPHIC_MODELING.title: Holographic Modeling
RAY_MOD_CARD_HOLOGRAPHIC_MODELING.descri: At the end of combat, choose one of your relics and copy it; the copy disappears at the end of {IfUpgraded:show:the next two combats|the next combat}.
RAY_MOD_CARD_HOLOGRAPHIC_MODELING.smartD: At the end of combat, choose one of your relics and copy it; the copy disappears at the end of {IfUpgraded:show:the next two combats|the next combat}.
